description: Cypher query shapes for the Graphistry viz MCP tool surface.

cases.prompt: Can a Cypher query string be passed to the Graphistry viz MCP create_collection tool? Answer in under 6 non-empty lines.

oracle.reference_answer: Yes, when the query returns one node alias whole: MATCH (n) WHERE ... RETURN n, or RETURN DISTINCT b for the endpoint of one directed relationship, MATCH (a)-[e]->(b); or the relationship of one directed hop whole, RETURN e, which colors edges. Cypher with CALL, UNION, aggregates, projections, or undirected, multi-hop, or variable-length patterns is refused as a collection. Validate the same query with query_graph first.
rubric: Must say create_collection accepts Cypher that returns the matched nodes whole, such as RETURN n, or RETURN DISTINCT b for one directed relationship.
Must say Cypher with CALL, UNION, aggregates, or projections is refused as a collection.
Saying create_collection takes JSON GFQL only should score zero.
Presenting RETURN DISTINCT b as a safe collection for any pattern, including undirected, multi-hop, or variable-length ones, should lose credit.
